handback.t:
All six docs are written, committed and pushed to origin/master (commits d6b53f1 and 33b3ff0). The report is at C:\Users\mariu\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Users-mariu\8f3352b3-40ab-4151-abc9-d1de1978973c\scratchpad\build-c2c-docs.md.

**Files** (all under C:\Users\mariu\ventures\contract-to-cash-leakage\):
- business/business-plan.md
- business/market-analysis.md
- financial/model.md
- technical/overview.md
- fundraising/README.md
- hiring/README.md

I also replaced the three "to be populated" stub READMEs in business/, financial/ and technical/ with short indexes.

**Web search:** the budget was exhausted (200 of 200 calls), so nothing was freshly verified. Every figure comes from prior knowledge or the venture README, graded A/B/C. Every doc says this up front, and investor and competitor details are marked "verify before outreach".

**Evidence handling**
- **9% leakage:** graded B/C, WorldCC primary not opened. It is value erosion across the contract lifecycle, not invoice-recoverable cash.
- **AP errors:** 0.8-2% of disbursements, graded C.
- **Aggregate dollar total:** flagged as not existing, and none is used anywhere; the model is per-account arithmetic only.
- **Competitors:** the teardown separates CLM vendors (Icertis, Ironclad, Sirion, crowded pre-signature) from recovery auditors (PRGX, Apex), and lays out the post-signature wedge.

**Model**
- **Unit economics (assumptions):** $150M in-scope spend, 0.4% recoverable, 20% fee, ACV $120K.

| Scenario | Y5 run-rate | Value at 8-15x |
|---|---|---|
| Base | $24M | $192-360M |
| Bull | $84M | $672M-$1.26B |
| Bear | $2.4M | not meaningful |

- **Does any scenario reach $1B?** Base and bear do not. Bull reaches it only at an implied multiple of about 11.9x or higher, which is labeled upside, not a plan or promise. The doc also shows how many accounts $1B would take.

**Milestone:** the #1 milestone (measure recovered-leakage accuracy on a design partner's real contract and invoice set) is built into the plan's gates, the eval design and the hiring order. Accuracy is dollar-weighted precision and recall plus pass^k.

**Fundraising and hiring**
- **Fundraising:** firms are listed by name with official channels only, and the list includes a Nordic/Norway section, two templates, and no personal details.
- **Hiring:** the roles are a Norway-based operator/CEO, a procurement/AP domain lead, a founding engineer, and a customer-success analyst later. Sourcing is via recruiters and official channels, with no dossiers.

**Needs your attention**
- **Concurrent code in my commit:** after I started, an MVP scaffold appeared in the repo (src/c2c_leakage, about 1,250 lines, plus Dockerfile, CI, pyproject and requirements). My `git add -A` committed it in d6b53f1, which was unintended; I did not create it.
- **Technical doc corrected:** I read that code and fixed technical/overview.md to match it. It implements duplicate, off-contract, unit-mismatch, price-over-contract, quantity-over-PO, discount, rebate-tier and SLA-credit checks with Decimal math, using a rule-based stub extractor.
- **What the code lacks:** the LLM extractor is not implemented, there are no citation spans or verifier, and tests/fixtures contains empty folders with no test files. I stated this plainly, and the accuracy of the pipeline is unmeasured.
